title: Palantir's Karp renews attacks on frontier AI labs that are 'trying to drug addict us'
summary_full: Karp said Chinese models can't be blamed for distilling U.S. models when the frontier labs "distilled all the value of IP, everywhere."
summary_public: Karp said Chinese models can't be blamed for distilling U.S. models when the frontier labs "distilled all the value of IP, everywhere."
